# Risk type: precision/roundtrip_degradation

These 2 cases exercise the `precision/roundtrip_degradation` failure mode. Run your function against all of them to check how it behaves.

## Use GeoCase in your tests

Install the complete set of vector, raster, and NetCDF dependencies:

```bash
pip install "geocase[all]"
```

[View GeoCase on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/geocase/).
